definitions.name: U3D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of the largest value, the first of them when several tie

definitions.name: U3D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES U3D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key holding the largest value, the earliest key when several tie

definitions.name: U3D.SPJOIN
definitions.body: [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined with single spaces ('' for empty)

definitions.name: U3D.CAP
definitions.body: 'CW' BIND CW CHARS 0 GET UPPER CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty String -> first character upper-cased, the rest lower-cased

definitions.name: U3D.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number, element-wise over a Vector

definitions.name: U3D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: U3D.BSIGNS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector with 1 for each opening bracket ( [ and -1 for each closing one

definitions.name: U3D.BREDUCE
definitions.note: String -> the String with every adjacent () and [] pair deleted once

definitions.name: U3D.BNORM
definitions.body: U3D.BREDUCE U3D.BREDUCE U3D.BREDUCE U3D.BREDUCE U3D.BREDUCE U3D.BREDUCE
definitions.note: bracket String of at most 12 chars -> its irreducible form after deleting all adjacent matched pairs ('' iff balanced)

definitions.name: U3D.NAMES
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> Vector of the names, in order

definitions.name: U3D.AMTS
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> Vector of the amounts, in order

definitions.name: U3D.LBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> Record from each name to the sum of its amounts, first-appearance order

definitions.name: U3D.RLE
definitions.body: [ [ '#' 0 ] ] [ 'X' BIND 'ACC' BIND ACC -1 GET [ 'LV' 'LC' ] BIND ACC -1 DROP X LC 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT ACC X 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 LV X EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD 1 DROP
definitions.note: Vector -> run-length encoding as a Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: U3D.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 0 [ 'RB' BIND 'RA' BIND RA 1 ADD 0 RB SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of truth values -> length of the longest run of adjacent TRUEs (0 if none)

definitions.name: U3D.PRESENT
definitions.note: Vector -> its non-NIL elements, in order

definitions.name: U3D.GAPS
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP U3D.RLE [ 0 GET ] FILTER [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of the lengths of each run of consecutive NILs, in order (empty if none)
